qa.what_happened: During the final days of the study, I remained silent as instructed, while other prisoners were given verbal warnings for not complying with the silence rule. The guards became increasingly frustrated with one particular prisoner, 9768, who refused to communicate even when given multiple warnings.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Prisoner 4771, I adhered to the silence rule strictly and did not break any of the guidelines set by the study, unlike some of the other prisoners.

qa.what_happened: I was repeatedly warned by the guards to stop being silent, but I continued to remain silent as a form of protest against what I believe is an unethical study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I chose to remain silent throughout most interactions as a way to express my concerns.
